title: Align agents --check with the bridge selected by init --codex
summary: Align agents --check with the bridge selected by init --codex
description:
Reported from the cli-test review and Orbitfall project exercise on 2026-09-04. Installed tools: Lore 0.4.1 and Quest 0.3.2, macOS ARM64. Source review revisions: Lore 054e6590f1b81fda418c9891611f84fd35aacf6e; Quest dcb06f6520e08f2755c04166cca168318a94ae5a. Findings describe those tested versions, not a claim that current HEAD was retested. Evidence paths below are retained in the sibling cli-test checkout; the reproduction and outcomes are also included here. Filing is not a fix.

In a fresh disposable Git repository with Quest initialized:
  lore init --yes --tracker quest --codex
  lore agents --check --json
Observed: exit 6; the check proposes creating .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md while the selected Codex bridge is unchanged. Installing both bridges makes the check pass. Orbitfall likewise needed lore agents to add the Claude bridge before a clean check.
Expected: check the selected/installed bridge set by default, or provide an explicit documented bridge scope so a valid Codex-only setup can pass its drift check. LCLI-281 (Done) implemented independent bridge selection at init; this follow-up concerns the consistency of its resulting check contract.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A fresh supported Codex-only initialization has a documented drift-check command that exits 0 without requiring another bridge.
Check scope and defaults are explicit in help/instructions.
Regression coverage includes Codex-only, Claude-only, both bridges and actual selected-bridge drift.
